text:
This Jinx vs Vi fight is epic (shame about that slow-motion jump where Jinx’s body twists in an impossible way, even for her flexibility 🙂), but what really matters here is how, with a well-structured and highly descriptive prompt, you can recreate famous characters without ever naming them.

Just to give you an idea, this prompt is 3,049 characters long, close to the maximum allowed in Seedance 2.0.

👉 If you want to learn how to create prompts like this for Seedance 2.0, I’ll be teaching it to my subscribers.
content:
Use a well-structured, highly descriptive prompt to recreate famous characters without naming them  
Write long prompts (up to ~3,049 characters, near the Seedance 2.0 maximum) to pack in more descriptive detail

translations.es:
Usa un prompt bien estructurado y altamente descriptivo para recrear personajes famosos sin nombrarlos  
Escribe prompts largos (hasta ~3,049 caracteres, cerca del máximo de Seedance 2.0) para incluir más detalles descriptivos
translations.fr:
Utilisez un prompt bien structuré et très descriptif pour recréer des personnages célèbres sans les nommer  
Rédigez des prompts longs (jusqu'à ~3 049 caractères, près du maximum de Seedance 2.0) pour inclure plus de détails descriptifs

より多くの詳細を詰め込むために、長いプロンプト（最大約3,049文字、Seedance 2.0の最大値に近い）を書いてください
translations.ko:

더 많은 묘사적 세부사항을 담기 위해 긴 프롬프트를 작성하세요 (최대 ~3,049자, Seedance 2.0의 최대치에 근접)
translations.pt-BR:
